title: ⚒️Build Contest & General Updates
author: Jonathan Hill
excerpt: Hey everyone, been a while! Today we've got a new build contest kicking off, and a few general updates.
body:
Hey everyone, been a while! Today we've got a new build contest kicking off, and a few general updates.

🍻Build Contest: Tavern

A place for drinking, stories, perhaps sparring? Rustic inn, pirate bar, snowy lodge - whatever "tavern" means to you.

📅Due Date: Thursday, August 21, 2025 1:59 AM CDT

This event is also listed on the calendar.

  • ✏️Prize Info: ⁠⚒ Build Contest Overview

  • 🏆Special Prize: Entrants for the top 3 submissions earn +1 charm slot and a free Fermentation Barrel charm.

📝General Updates

  • 🎃Pumpkins can now be carved in a stonecutter. This does not drop seeds like carving by hand does.

  • 🟩Slime and magma cube heads now drop more reliably. This also fixes them never dropping from the Wishbone charm.

  • 💎Boundary Shards can no longer be used in uncorruptible locales and don't get you stuck in the disenchant mode once used at the Arcanum.

  • 🌍Recasting Aphelion of Earth's spell for Curse of the Forbidden Ones now moves the existing obelisk without resetting sacrifice progress. This is generally useful, but notably also makes it usable on Corrupted Footage charms.

🫶
